t=np.zeros((1,2,112));t[0,0,:4]=[1,2,.0005,.001]
arrays=[t,np.ones(2),np.array([[2,2],[10,10]]),np.zeros((2,2)),np.zeros((1,2,39)),np.zeros((1,2,39)),np.zeros((1,2,6)),np.zeros((1,2,29))]

 d=Path(tmp);report=r.preserve(raw,d,[dict(seed=1),dict(seed=2)])
